A '''member''' of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]]'s [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]], under the callsign [[Rogue Seven/Legends|Rogue Seven]], was present during the [[Second Battle of Sernpidal]]. The pilot was shot down and killed by a [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[yorik-et]].
